subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Betrey.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Betrey"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "Betray" which means to be disloyal to someone or something. (धोखा देना)
 
 
• **Example: **He felt that she would never betray his trust.
 
 
 
• **"Betray" **refers to the act of being disloyal or treacherous to someone or something. (धोखा देना)
 
 
• **Example: **She betrayed her best friend by revealing her secret.
